author: PJthePlayer
quote: Rockstar decided not to launch on PC, so enjoy the 0 review score which reflects my ability to play the game. Guess we'll wait for the 20 FPS console beta testers before the inevitable PC version.

author: PJthePlayer
quote: What an amazing experience. As someone who has been playing this series since the very beginning, it was a nostalgia trip tailor-made for people like me.  This game is so good it has the highest user rating on this entire website, which has fans of other fans writing fake negative reviews to try to bring it down .

author: PJthePlayer
quote:
BE AWARE:  This game is receiving targeted review bombing mostly from Sony fans that are upset it isn't on their console.  These reviews have nothing to do with the actual quality of the game and should be disregarded.

Realistically I would give this game around a 9.5 but I'm giving it a 10 to offset the troll review bombers.  This is easily Bethesda's best game since Skyrim and one of the best RPGs ever made.  The sheer amount of things available to do is almost overwhelming when you start out.  The main quest can be completely ignored if you wish due to the massive amount of quality side quests and the amazing ship building system.  I have spent literal hours customizing my ship with new rooms and weapons which is just awesome.

author: PJthePlayer
quote: A phenomenal game and most likely to be Game of the Year 2023 in my opinion.  Once this game came out it essentially made all other ARPGs irrelevant.  Unfortunately it's receiving a review-bombing campaign by people who have a number of irrelevant issues with it (can't afford it, don't like the cosmetic-only microtransactions, etc) so I decided to leave a positive review that actually reviews the game itself instead of someone's financial issues.

author: PJthePlayer
quote: Seems like a lot of people with potato PCs are hating on this game.  It did have a stuttering issue at launch which was resolved in less than 24 hours with a patch.  The game itself is fantastic and a solid spiritual successor to Dead Space.  I have a high-end gaming PC and experienced no issues whatsoever from start to finish twice (second playthrough to finish it on Maximum Security difficulty).  This is a 2022 AAA release with some of the best graphics ever in a video game and your computer needs to be up to par.  Don't expect it to run well on a budget machine.

author: PJthePlayer
quote:
Many games are p2w and while that's never acceptable this game is so disgustingly p2w that it's clear that the developers literally spent time studying the psychology of addictive personalities so that they could design the game to maximize earnings.  Currency packs are sold in numbers that make them just under how much you need so you have to buy double for example and they escalate in cost the more you purchase (first pack is only one dollar... kind of like how a drug dealer operates).
You even have to pay to open the loot chest you get from defeating a boss!  Absolutely despicable and predatory.  Gamers need to stand against this kind of ridiculous monetization.  This game makes me fear that Diablo 4 will also be ruined by p2w microtransactions.

author: PJthePlayer
quote: A fantastic and original game.  It's so much fun to take these spaceships apart meticulously and manage to get a perfect salvage score.  The graphics are great, the gameplay has enough variety to keep it interesting, and it even has a decent story.  Another hit from the amazing Blackbird Interactive!

author: PJthePlayer
quote: Apparently people are review-bombing the game because it's a "ripoff" of Zelda which is ridiculous.  Should all FPS games be ridiculed because they're ripoffs of Wolfenstein 3D?  Give me a break.  This game is also being criticized for being too hard by people who apparently totally missed that it even has a built-in god mode for people who struggle with it.  It's a great little indie game that is definitely worth your time.  Ignore the review-bombers and form your own opinion.  I wouldn't give it a 10 except I'm purposefully countering the unwarranted 0 scores from abusive review-bombers.

author: PJthePlayer
quote: Absolutely fantastic and the best racing game of all time in my opinion.  This is a serious contender for Game of the Year depending on how well Halo Infinite does.  The small amount of people literally giving it a "0" are obvious Sony fanboys or trolls of other sorts.

author: PJthePlayer
quote:
Ignore the ignorant saltlords that are bombing this game simply because it is on Epic instead of Steam.
The game is fantastic and Mechwarrior fans will love it.

author: PJthePlayer
quote:
Don't believe the misinformation about high end PCs not being able to run this game.  I have a high end but not top of the line PC and it runs outstandingly well for me (8700k/1080Ti) at 1440p it averages between 80-100 FPS at Ultra settings and is silky smooth on my Gsync display.

I have a 15 year old Steam account with over 800 games but I also see that the industry is changing for the better thanks to competition.  Developers get 88% of their profits when they sell games on Epic while they only get 70% on Steam - common sense to go with Epic.  Steam needs to stop being so greedy and they could easily, EASILY reduce their cut and win these games back but they won't.

As far as the game itself - what an amazing game!  As a huge Borderlands fan from the start and having played all of them and all of the DLCs I have to say so far Borderlands 3 is my favorite of the entire series.  Moving and shooting have been vastly improved, the multiple planets and Sanctuary 3 are amazing to see and overall the game is a blast especially in coop.

author: PJthePlayer
quote: Giving it a 10 to counter the Steam trolls review bombing the game.  It probably deserves an 8 in my opinion.  Great game so far and a blast in coop.  Great graphics and truly impressive hordes.  It feels like a natural evolution of the Left 4 Dead series with XP and progression.  I love how using the guns you like leads to upgrades for those very guns which tailors the game to your playstyle.
